rachel: if this changes any public surface, add a deprecation note. runtime APIs are internal so ok. add a TODO comment linking the PR.
nana: plan: I'll run `make fmt`, adjust names, add TODO, and push a fixup in ~20m. command I'll run:
```bash
git mv runtime/kvcache.py runtime/kv_cache.py
git grep -l "\\bkvcache\\b" | xargs sed -i 's/\\bkvcache\\b/kv_cache/g'
make fmt
```
